description:
Check how a project is doing: what is in flight, what shipped, what is stuck.

    Returns lifecycle status, open task count, queued roadmap item count, runs
    today, verification pass rate, open blockers, pause state, and freshness.
    Zero `open_tasks` does not mean an empty roadmap: `queued_roadmap_items`
    counts planned work awaiting expansion, including work held while the
    scheduler is disabled. list_roadmap returns those items.

    Delivery vs verification: `prs_merged_today` is the DELIVERY signal
    (distinct PRs merged today). `pass_rate` is the local verification pass
    rate over the last 14 days of dev/QA iterations - NOT a delivery measure.
    `verify_decided_14d` is that ratio's denominator and `verify_errored_14d`
    its sandbox-timeout share: when errored dominates, pass_rate measures the
    verify budget, not the code. `open_escalations` is a COUNT; read
    list_escalations for the rows.

    Pause state is `scheduler_enabled`, `scheduler_paused_until` and
    `pause_reason`. Freshness is `last_iter_at`, `last_pm_iter_at`, and
    `last_successful_deploy_at` (a LEGACY pointer); read `deployment {merged,
    deployed, verified, last_deploy_attempt}` for the three facts kept
    separately, and treat only `verified` as a verified deployment.

    `pm_lane {last_pm_iter_at, repo_access}` is the planning lane's live
    health: repo_access 'failing' means that lane cannot read the repo from
    GitHub even while runs still start and `github_connected` reads true (that
    flag is presence-only).

    `glm_peak_paused` is NOT a fault and sets no pause columns: it is the
    ephemeral GLM peak-hours skip. True means clean PRs hold and runs stop
    until `glm_peak_resumes_at`. It is an intentional cost gate, so the accurate
    description is "waiting for off-peak", not a failure.

    `ui_review` is absent while the ui-review autonomy ladder is enabled (the
    default): the ladder owns that budget and the customer surface carries no
    scenario or capture controls. In the legacy mode it is present for
    `web_app` projects and reports scenarios/scenario_cap/captures/capture_cap
    from the default branch's `ui-review.json` (both caps are enforced at push
    time, not in your CI); it can mint a GitHub installation token to read it,
    so the call is then not guaranteed to be a purely local read.

    `model_roles` (only when the Researcher/Integrator feature is enabled for
    the project) reports each optional stage's on/off configuration and last
    outcome.
name: project_status
title: Get Project Status
